channel.title: Omaste Witkowski: each piece in a thousand words
channel.description: A picture is worth a thousand words. Each story tells one artwork by Omaste Witkowski in about a thousand.

item.title: A Rose That Looks Cast in Glowing Gold Metal
item.dc:creator: Omaste Witkowski
item.description: A familiar flower becomes a gilded relief, with bright ridged petals glowing against deep rust shadow. Read the story, then see the piece on your own wall at its real size.
